ShortDescription.Value: Bring real places into your game: trace any city with a live map, and build maps with real terrain, water and trees in the editor.

Publish.LongDescription:
Real World Maps brings real places into Cities: Skylines II. Trace any city with a real map laid over the ground, and build the map itself from real elevation, water and trees, right inside the Map Editor. No external heightmap tools needed.
Formerly Map Overlay. This is a beta, and generated water can still need some touch-ups by hand.
**Projects** - One project per city. Create, load, save and delete them. - Each project remembers where its map sits and how it is shown. - Lock a project's map once it is in place, so it cannot shift by accident.
**Overlay (Map Editor and your city)** - Shows a real map over the terrain, like tracing paper, without changing your save. - Search for a place, an address, coordinates or a Google Maps / OpenStreetMap link. - Move and rotate the map by dragging it on the ground, with the arrows or with fine rotation steps. - Map scale from 25% to 200%, including the Terraining map size to match a heightmap. - Map styles: OpenStreetMap, Topographic or a custom tile URL with your own key. - Opacity, on top of everything or laid on the terrain, area size or the whole map.
**Terrain (Map Editor only)** - Generates the playable area and the world map from real elevation, framed exactly like your Overlay. - Sea, lakes, rivers and canals where they really are, with the water already in place when it finishes. - Terrain smoothing (Low, Medium, High) for clean, natural-looking ground. - Trees where the land cover says there is forest, with three densities. - Water sources are placed for you, inside the water.
**Good to know** - Generating terrain replaces the terrain, trees and water sources of the current map, and cannot be undone. Save first. - Terrain is locked outside the Map Editor, because it would damage a city in progress. - It needs an internet connection to download the map data. - Tree species are a general mix, not chosen by climate. - The interface is in English.
Open it with the button at the top left of a city, or in the row of tools at the bottom of the Map Editor.

Publish.ChangeLog: 0.3.0 beta: Map Overlay is now Real World Maps. - New: generate terrain in the Map Editor from real elevation, with sea, lakes, rivers, canals and trees. - New: water is placed as soon as the terrain finishes, so there is no long wait for it to fill. - New: projects, one per city, with a lock to keep the map in place. - New: separate Overlay and Terrain tabs. Terrain only works in the Map Editor. - New: button in the Map Editor's row of tools, and a panel you can drag anywhere. - Changed: the panel now follows the look of the game.
